value.contract: Provider and visible-line visitors pass only existing deduplicated eligible IDs in original order to attributes-only cursors of at most32 rows ordered by CASE, with one full original BLOB/geometry at a time and one lazy visit-owned compiled BLOB statement. Preserve typed fields/NULLs/full geometry, hidden/excluded/current/owner/content/style guards and existing style/clip/anchor/PBF/cache/gate/free-only contracts. Close cursors/descriptors/statements on success/error/cancel; reject missing/extra/reordered IDs or BLOB/decode failure instead of partial successful tiles. Default Access visitor preserves fixtures, original editor/sync APIs and producer/schema/saved-state formats stay unchanged. Existing typed phase definitions stay comparable to private843d; no native-ready or speed acceptance is implied.
